mapper.sql: outbox_id, certificate_id, business_round, idempotency_key, request_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_http_status, last_error_code, last_error_message, remote_instance_id, remote_status, remote_business_round, certificate_version, version, remote_succeeded_time, completed_time, manual_replay_count, manual_replay_by, manual_replay_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: insert ignore into hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox ( certificate_id, business_round, idempotency_key, request_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, certificate_version, version, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{certificateId}, #{businessRound}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{certificateVersion}, #{version}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select from hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox where outbox_id = #{outboxId} for update

select from hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox where (status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= #{dueTime})) or status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' or (status = 'SUBMITTING' and update_time <= #{staleSubmittingBefore}) order by case status when 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' then 0 when 'SUBMITTING' then 1 when 'RETRY' then 2 else 3 end, coalesce(next_retry_time, create_time), outbox_id limit #{limit}

select o.outbox_id outboxId, o.certificate_id certificateId, o.business_round businessRound, o.idempotency_key idempotencyKey, o.status, o.retry_count retryCount, o.next_retry_time nextRetryTime, o.last_http_status lastHttpStatus, o.last_error_code lastErrorCode, o.last_error_message lastErrorMessage, o.remote_instance_id remoteInstanceId, o.remote_status remoteStatus, o.remote_business_round remoteBusinessRound, o.version, o.manual_replay_count manualReplayCount, o.manual_replay_by manualReplayBy, o.manual_replay_time manualReplayTime, o.create_time createTime, o.update_time updateTime from hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox o left join hr_employee_health_certificate c on c.certificate_id = o.certificate_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where 1 = 1 and o.outbox_id = #{outboxId} and o.status = #{status} ${params.dataScope} order by case o.status when 'FAILED' then 0 when 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' then 1 when 'SUBMITTING' then 2 when 'RETRY' then 3 else 4 end, o.update_time desc, o.outbox_id desc

select coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) pendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'RETRY' then 1 else 0 end), 0) retryCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'SUBMITTING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) submittingCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) remoteSucceededCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) failedCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) succeededCount, min(case when o.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'SUBMITTING', 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED') then o.create_time end) oldestWaitingTime, coalesce(timestampdiff(second, min(case when o.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'SUBMITTING', 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED') then o.create_time end), sysdate()), 0) oldestWaitingSeconds from hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox o left join hr_employee_health_certificate c on c.certificate_id = o.certificate_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where 1 = 1 ${params.dataScope}

select o.* from hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox o inner join hr_employee_health_certificate c on c.certificate_id = o.certificate_id and c.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where o.outbox_id = #{outboxId} ${params.dataScope} for update
mapper.update: update hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox set status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED', remote_instance_id = #{remoteInstanceId}, remote_status = #{remoteStatus}, remote_business_round = #{remoteBusinessRound}, remote_succeeded_time = sysdate(), next_retry_time = null, last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error_code = null, last_error_message = null, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and version = #{version}

update hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox set status = 'FAILED', next_retry_time = null, last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{lastErrorMessage}, remote_instance_id = coalesce(#{remoteInstanceId}, remote_instance_id), remote_status = coalesce(#{remoteStatus}, remote_status), remote_business_round = coalesce(#{remoteBusinessRound}, remote_business_round), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and version = #{version}

update hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox o inner join hr_employee_health_certificate c on c.certificate_id = o.certificate_id and c.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id set o.status = case when o.remote_instance_id is not null and o.remote_business_round = o.business_round then 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' else 'RETRY' end, o.retry_count = 0, o.next_retry_time = sysdate(), o.last_http_status = null, o.last_error_code = null, o.last_error_message = null, o.manual_replay_count = o.manual_replay_count + 1, o.manual_replay_by = #{operator}, o.manual_replay_time = sysdate(), o.update_by = #{operator}, o.version = o.version + 1, o.update_time = sysdate() where o.outbox_id = #{query.outboxId} and o.status = 'FAILED' and o.version = #{version} and coalesce(o.last_error_code, '') not in ( 'REMOTE_ROUND_MISMATCH', 'INSTANCE_CONFLICT', 'CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND', 'CERTIFICATE_STATE_CHANGED', 'CERTIFICATE_VERSION_CONFLICT', 'CERTIFICATE_ROUND_CHANGED' ) ${query.params.dataScope}
